scope: cross-method candidate consensus and focused normal-size visual review of all current v2 atlases

method.name: cross-method consensus with PREV/CURRENT/NEXT and alpha silhouette sheet
method.purpose: intersect independent raster/display review candidates before visual promotion, then inspect each intersection with temporal neighbors and a color-independent silhouette
method.selection: distinct methods per role/row/frame; method count is a triage signal, not an automatic failure
method.presentation: previous/current/next at 192x208 plus the current binary alpha silhouette; known blockers are labeled only on the focused review sheet

result.release_effect: supplemental evidence only; the four complete-row regeneration blockers remain open

confirmed_existing_blockers: hei-mao-delivery/failed frames 0-4 repeated head and pose-family switch
visual_review.note: Focused intersections were reviewed at normal cell size with temporal neighbors and alpha silhouettes; no additional hard failure was promoted.

limitations: Candidate intersection still operates on raster and display evidence; it is not live Codex App capture.
A method count cannot distinguish a shared legitimate gesture from a defect; normal-size review and hatch-pet policy remain authoritative.
The focused sheet does not verify multi-screen z-order, bubble tracking, GPU composition, or user-level App interactions.
